people.imagined: The armillary hall at night, the great rings above. The ancient head tilts his bald head back and looks at a visitor as if the person were slightly out of focus and the sky behind them were not.
people.subject: The moment: under the dim brass rings of an armillary at night he tips his bald head back and gazes at the viewer with a vague, far-focused stare, as if the real thing were behind them and the sky were not out of focus. Face (most important: the bald head and the dried-riverbed lines): a very small, very old face like a dried river bed, cracked all over with deep fine wrinkles, a domed bald head spotted with age, a tiny sharp nose, pale unfocused grey eyes under no eyebrows, a wide thin closed mouth; about ninety. Hair: none, a bald head crowned with a small crown of dark star-iron, a short wispy white goatee. Body: small, frail, bent, dwarfed by his robe. Clothing: the head's richest robes: star-chart brocade of dry-grass gold and night-blue silk with constellations in silver thread, three crossed collars, a night-blue gauze over-robe scattered with tiny silver stars that drifts round him, very wide sleeves, a sash with a thin cord and a dark star-iron rod hanging as a pendant. Hands and objects: a small black stone mirror in a bronze rim held in both hands at his chest; in his belt a staff bearing seven tiny flags in a line. Power: a vast, quiet aura of amber-gold Earth qi with silver motes of starlight orbiting slowly round his head like a tiny sky, and a faint pale gold Light glow in the mirror. Background: a dim hall of enormous brass rings, circles within circles, blurred, a slit of night sky and drifting mist. Light: dim cool starlight from the upper left, a thread of silver on the rings and a soft rim glow along his skull. Expression: remote and far-seeing, amused somewhere very far behind the pale eyes, in no hurry for anything.

people.imagined: On the armillary's winding platform at dusk. She turns the star-iron ring on her finger as she tells someone, in an even voice, what she is going to carry to the Pivot's court in open session.
people.subject: The moment: standing on the stone platform of the armillary at dusk she turns a dark ring on her finger with her thumb as she tells someone, in an even voice, what she will carry to the Pivot's court in open session. Face: a long, honest, upright face with a high forehead, a straight nose, level dark eyes under straight brows, a firm mouth; weathered skin, a few lines at the eyes; about fifty. Hair: black with silver at the temples, in a tight topknot held by a short dark star-iron pin, not a strand loose, the pin set exactly vertical. Body: tall, straight, long-necked, poised. Clothing: an elder's robes of dry-grass gold and night-blue silk, three crossed collars, the night-blue gauze over-robe scattered with tiny embroidered silver stars, sleeves bound at the wrist with silk cord so they cannot catch, a short cloak of dry-gold silk over the shoulders; neat to the last fold. Hands and objects: ink-stained cuffs clearly visible; a ring of dull dark star iron turned by her left thumb; in her right a ring of twelve small pennants on a short staff. Power: a steady ochre-gold Earth aura with fine silver Metal motes circling her ring hand, firm and orderly. Background: the pale bronze arcs of an armillary against a violet dusk, blurred in mist. Light: low violet dusk from the left with a warm edge on her face, the brass arcs behind her catching a long band of violet and gold. Expression: a stern, level look with the jaw set and the eyes a little narrowed, as if the answer has already been decided and the listener is late.

people.imagined: On the plateau road beside a cart of star-iron discs, he winds his measuring cord round his neck again and beams at a granary master, calculating how soon he can ring every granary in the land.
people.subject: The moment: on the plateau road beside a cart of star-iron discs he winds his measuring cord round his neck again and beams at a granary master off-frame, calculating how soon he can ring every granary in the land. Face: a round, busy, ruddy face with plump cheeks, a short thick nose, small quick brown eyes, a wide smiling mouth with a hard greedy edge, a double chin; about forty-five. Hair: black, in a short topknot held by a dark star-iron pin. Body: round, short, brisk, bouncing on small feet, belly pushing against the belt, short legs planted wide, chin tucked and eyebrows raised in a salesman's good cheer. Clothing: graceful dry-grass gold silk robes belted high over the belly, a stiff stand-up collar edged with a thin night-blue band, cuffs turned back twice to show a lining of pale silk, a night-blue gauze over-robe with a few tiny silver stars, a sash with a bundle of knotted measuring cords and a small round paper tag. Hands and objects: a long knotted measuring cord looped round his neck to the chest; the right hand holds a dark disc of star iron with a ring pattern; a short bronze hammer hangs from his belt on a tassel; behind him a cart stacked with similar dark grey discs. Power: a faint ochre Earth shimmer on the discs and a silver Metal glint on their rims. Background: a wide plateau road with dry yellow plain and pale sky, a distant train of carts and one slim column of dust, mist. Light: bright, clear light from the upper left, a short hard shadow under his chin and a glint on the discs. Expression: a jovial beam, warm on top and sharply calculating underneath, with a cold edge at the corners of the smile.

people.imagined: The reed hut by the lake at night. She is sitting on the shore with her eyes on a reflected patch of water where a star should be, and has just heard a step behind her and not turned.
people.subject: The moment: at night on the shore of a dark lake beside her reed hut she sits in profile, eyes fixed on a reflected patch of water where a star should be, and has just heard a step behind her and not turned. Face (most important: very pale, unseen by day): a pale, quiet, long face the colour of milk, fine cheekbones, large dark eyes with a faint silver glint, narrow level brows, a small mouth; about thirty-five. Hair: black, long, loose to the waist with a few strands wet from mist, tied at the end with a night-blue silk cord, beads of mist clinging to the ends. Body: slight, still, wrapped. Clothing: dry-grass gold silk robes in two crossed collars, long sleeves, a night-blue gauze over-robe scattered with tiny silver stars like the sky she watches, a soft grey silk shawl round the shoulders, a sash with a small dark star-iron pendant. Hands and objects: a round dark mirror held in the lap, its surface showing a few small points of light; a tea bowl beside her; a lit oil lamp on a stone. Power: pale silver Water qi gathers on the mirror, and tiny star-motes lift off it and drift across her hands. Background: a still black lake with a scatter of stars reflected in it, a low reed hut, blurred in mist. Light: pale starlit blue from above left, silver on the water, a faint silver ripple of reflected stars lying across her cheek. Expression: very still, listening with her whole body and not turning, a small crease of worry between the brows.

people.imagined: At the mine mouth, a disc of star iron in his hand rings with a clear note and he hums along without noticing, heavy and slow and quite happy.
people.subject: The moment: at the mouth of a mine he holds up a dark disc of star iron and taps it, humming along with its clear ringing note, eyes closed, heavy and slow and quite happy. Face: a heavy, slow, broad face with a thick jaw, small half-closed brown eyes, thick brows, a flat nose, a mouth open humming; stubble; about forty-five. Hair: black, cropped short, dusty. Body: heavy, thick, slow, powerful shoulders, thick neck, the head tilted a little toward the disc as if he were listening to a friend, one boot set on a stone. Clothing: dry-grass gold silk robes with a night-blue collar, a dark-grey silk over-robe with iron-studded cuffs that hold a dull blue shine from heat, a tied sash; the robe has a neat matching panel at the elbow and dust at the hem; graceful silk worn by a heavy man. Hands and objects: a dark grey disc of star iron held in the left hand and tapped with a small hammer in the right; at his feet a sack of identical discs; his knuckles are scarred and blackened, and a small bag of barley hangs at the belt. Power: a silver Metal ring-shimmer round the disc, rings of faint light spreading with each note, over a low amber glow of Earth qi. Background: loose rails of an ore tramway running into the dark mine mouth, small carts, a thin flock of birds crossing a pale sky, mist. Light: bright dry light from the upper left, a faint silver glint on the disc, and a sliver of sun showing a ring of iridescent colour on its face. Expression: a dreamy, half-hidden contentment, the eyes shut and the mouth soft, as though he keeps a small secret in the note.

people.imagined: The chart room, lamp lit. He squints one milky eye through a rock-crystal lens at an old chart pinned beside a new sailor's chart, and has not yet decided whom to trust.
people.subject: The moment: in the chart room by lamplight he squints one milky eye through a rock-crystal lens at an old star chart pinned beside a new sailor's chart, and has not yet decided whom to trust. Face (most important: one milky white eye): a thin, narrow, suspicious face with a hooked nose, one eye clouded entirely milky white, the other black and sharp, squinting through a round crystal lens, grey bristly brows, a thin down-turned mouth; about fifty-five. Hair: grey, thin, in a small topknot with a dark star-iron pin. Body: lean, hunched over the table, crabbed, one shoulder higher than the other from a lifetime at a low table, neck jutting forward like a heron's. Clothing: dry-grass gold silk robes with a high night-blue collar fastened by a single bone button, ink-stained wide sleeves tied at the wrist with black silk cord so they will not smear the charts, a night-blue gauze over-robe with a few embroidered silver stars, a sash holding a roll of fine paper strips. Hands and objects: a rock-crystal lens on a short handle in the right hand; a dark chart with white pin-pricks of stars on the table and beside it a second chart in a different hand; a jar of small marked tokens; nails cut very short, fingertips grey with chalk. Power: a faint amber Earth glow in the lens and a few silver star-motes caught in its curve. Background: a dim chart room with rolled maps on shelves, a long dark chart dotted with white stars and beside it a second chart in brighter ink with blue coastlines, blurred. Light: lamp from the lower right, shadow on half of the face, the milky eye shining like a pearl. Expression: a suspicious, absorbed squint, the thin mouth turned down, trusting neither ink.

people.imagined: On the plateau, laying a ward ring in the dust with his loud laugh startling the lake geese; he has just been told a richer camp sent for him and is half-grinning toward the road.
people.subject: The moment: on the plateau he stands in a half-laid circle of star-iron discs, mid-laugh, one foot already turned toward the road, having just been told a richer camp sent for him. Face: a long, brown, lively face with a wide mouth open in a booming laugh, bright dark eyes, thick brows, a prominent nose, high cheekbones; about twenty. Hair: black, tousled, tied up with a bit of night-blue cord. Body: tall, lanky, loose-limbed, energetic, leaning on one hip with a bounce in his heel as if about to start walking, Adam's apple prominent. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple robe of dry-grass gold silk with a night-blue crossed collar, sleeves rolled to the elbow, hem shortened so it does not drag in the dust, a silk sash, a travel satchel of grey silk across the chest; straw sandals. Hands and objects: in the right hand a small dark flag on a stick; the left holding a dark star-iron disc; a ring of discs laid out in the dust at his feet; a scrap of paper with a rough circle diagram sticking out of the satchel. Power: a faint ochre Earth glimmer rising off the half-laid ring, nothing grand. Background: a wide yellow plain, a lake with a flock of geese taking off, small black yaks grazing at its edge, a distant line of low hills and one tall flag-pole at a camp, light mist. Light: bright spirit-sun from the upper left, the geese beating up a glitter of spray behind him. Expression: a loud, open, restless grin, eyes already on the next road and the bigger offer, carefree.

people.imagined: The scriptorium at night; the broad forearms of a cook's daughter push out of narrow copyist's sleeves as she copies. She stops and looks up, her mind elsewhere with her mother out on the plain.
people.subject: The moment: in the scriptorium at night she looks up from the copying desk, brush paused, her mind elsewhere with her mother out on the plain. Face (most important: broad cook's forearms in narrow copyist's sleeves): a plain, honest, round face with a wide forehead, clear brown eyes, soft straight brows, a short nose, a pressed mouth; about twenty-five. Hair: black, in a neat bun with a bamboo pin, a smudge of ink on the temple. Body: sturdy, wide-shouldered, thick-armed, back a little rounded from long copying, her wrists resting on the table so as to show the width of her forearms. Clothing: dry-grass gold silk robes with a high night-blue collar fastened to the chin, narrow tight sleeves that stop short of the wrists so her thick forearms stick out, ink running in thin lines down the inner sleeve, a night-blue gauze over-robe with a few tiny silver stars, a plain strip of undyed silk as belt; graceful and plain. Hands and objects: a brush held over a page of pale paper marked only with small repeated circles; large forearms resting on the desk edge; a small lamp; an open copy of a book covered with neat black circles within circles and tiny hatch-marks. Power: a faint ochre Earth glow and a few silver motes rising from the circles on the page. Background: a quiet room with a shelf of a dozen identical bound volumes, a clay water-dropper and a small wooden figure of a yak, blurred in lamp-mist. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left, throwing her shadow tall on the wall. Expression: a plain, steady face gone distant and a little sorrowful, thinking of someone far away across the dark.

people.imagined: At dusk on the lake path with a pot of butter tea for the watcher; she talks low as if the wind were listening, tea staining her sleeve, a yak plodding behind.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk she walks along the lake path with a covered pot of butter tea for the watcher, speaking low as if the wind were listening, tea staining her sleeve, a yak plodding behind. Face: a round, cheerful, wind-reddened face with high pink cheeks, bright dark eyes, a snub nose, a small smiling mouth; about seventeen. Hair: black, in two thick braids tied with red silk cord, a small cap of grey felt-silk with ear flaps tied under her chin. Body: sturdy, small, bundled, quick on her feet, leaning slightly forward into the wind with short quick steps. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple robe of dry-grass gold silk with a long sleeve stained with tea down one side, a night-blue sash, a quilted warm vest of pale silk turned lining-out, soft boots embroidered with a thin red zigzag. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped round a round clay tea pot wrapped in cloth; a second smaller cup hangs on a cord from her belt, ready for the watcher; behind her a shaggy yak with a wooden bell plodding along. Power: a faint ochre warmth and a few gold motes in the steam rising from the pot. Background: a dark lake, a low reed hut with a thin light in its window, one long-haired yak standing among the reeds, dusk mist. Light: low pink dusk light from the upper left, the last pink edging the clouds and tinting the steam, a soft rim along her cheek. Expression: a warm, shy, brave little smile, lips moving on a secret murmur, eyes bright against the cold.

people.imagined: The mine workshop, the discs ringing round him. He is half asleep, lids drooping mid-sentence, and his answer arrives a breath after the question; he smiles lazily.
people.subject: The moment: in the mine workshop with the discs ringing round him he stands half asleep, lids drooping mid-sentence, about to answer a question out of frame a breath late, with a lazy smile. Face (most important: heavy drooping lids): a soft, round, sleepy face with half-closed brown eyes under drooping lids, thick soft brows, a snub nose, a slow lazy smile; about twenty-two. Hair: dark brown, floppy, uncombed, tied back with a night-blue cord. Body: soft, broad, slouching against a bench, round belly, soft knees, propped on one elbow, nearly asleep on his feet. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple robe of dry-grass gold silk with a night-blue crossed collar, open and crumpled at the neck, sleeves rolled, a dark-grey silk work-sash with a split pocket mended with blue thread, a scrap of angelica root tucked behind the belt. Hands and objects: a small hammer loosely in the right hand; a dark star-iron disc lying on the bench, his left hand resting on it, thumb stroking its rim; on racks behind him a dozen discs of different sizes on cords, each slightly swinging, beside a small tuning fork on a stand. Power: a faint silver Metal ring in the air round the discs, soft concentric ripples of light. Background: a workshop of hanging discs and tools, blurred in a warm haze. Light: soft light from the upper left, a pale ring of light from a high window falling on his hair. Expression: a drowsy, easy, unbothered half smile, in no hurry and not at all offended by the question.

people.imagined: By lamplight in the carving shed, a bow-legged wheelwright's son cuts a tiny date into the rim of a spare armillary ring, in the old hand, for the head, careful and quiet.
people.subject: The moment: by lamplight in the carving shed he bends over a ring and cuts a tiny date into the rim of a spare armillary ring with a fine chisel, in the old hand, for the head, careful and quiet, tongue between his teeth. Face: a narrow, serious, boyish face with a high forehead, dark careful eyes, soft brows drawn together, a long nose, the tip of a tongue between his lips; about seventeen. Hair: black, shaggy, tied with a night-blue cord. Body: short, thin, bow-legged stance, hunched, thighs bowed outward, elbows pressed to his ribs. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple robe of dry-grass gold silk with a night-blue collar, a little scorch at the hem, sleeves bound at the wrist with silk thongs, a dark silk work-sash with a loop holding three chisels of increasing size. Hands and objects: a fine chisel in the right hand and a small mallet in the left; a dark brass-grey armillary ring clamped on a stand; a thumb with a flat callus; a fine curl of metal falling from the chisel. Power: a thin gold Earth glow follows the chisel edge, a few silver shavings glittering as they fall. Background: a carving shed with ring parts on racks, three small wooden models of rings, a measuring staff, an hour-glass and rolls of rubbing paper in a jar, blurred. Light: a lamp from the lower right, bright on the ring, its polished edge reflecting a narrow gold line. Expression: an absorbed, secretive concentration, eyes small with care and lips pressed tight round the tongue.

people.imagined: The year he founded the abbey, a yak herder who watched the sky for fifty years before he cultivated: he stands on the high plain at night, a staff in hand, face turned up to the stars, just beginning to understand.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. In the year he founded the abbey, a yak herder who watched the sky for fifty years before he cultivated stands on the empty high plain at night, a staff in hand, face turned up to the stars, just beginning to understand. Face: a long, weathered, kind face, sunburnt to leather, deep creases, a long nose, large dark eyes full of wonder, grey bushy brows, a thin grey beard, a mouth open slightly; about sixty. Hair: grey, long, tied in a topknot with a dark star-iron pin. Body: tall, lean, sturdy, wiry from years outdoors. Clothing: the founder's robes as the abbey remembers him: a long dry-grass gold silk robe in two crossed collars, a night-blue gauze over-robe scattered with tiny silver stars, wide sleeves, a rope-twist sash with a small bell, soft boots; a quiet crown of star-iron. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a tall wooden staff; the left hand raised, a finger pointing at the stars; a small bell at his belt; a yak's dark shape beside him. Power: a faint pale-gold glimmer in his eyes and a drift of silver star-motes gathering above his raised finger, the first of his Earth qi waking. Background: an empty plain, a lake with a faint dipper of stars reflected, a vast night sky, mist, blurred. Light: pale starlight from the upper left, the wind lifting the hem of his robe and the tips of his grey hair, his breath rising in a small slow cloud, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: wonder and humble devotion, mouth a little open, as if the sky had finally spoken.

people.imagined: The year he went blind, leading his star-readers across the plain to Củng Tinh with their charts; an old man with a proud blank stare, one hand on a young reader's shoulder and the other clutching a rolled chart.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. The year he went blind he leads his star-readers across the plain to Củng Tinh with their charts, a blind old head walking forward proudly with one hand on a young reader's shoulder and the other clutching a roll of charts. Face: a proud, gaunt, aquiline face with a hooked nose, a high forehead, blank white clouded eyes staring straight ahead, thick white brows, a thin tight mouth, a long white beard; about eighty. Hair: white and long, swept back from a high forehead under a small black crown-cap of dark star-iron. Body: tall, thin, upright, rigid with pride. Clothing: an elder's richest robes: a long robe of night-blue and dry-grass gold brocade with constellations in silver thread and tiny stars embroidered at every border, a wide dark sash, a heavy over-cloak of night-blue gauze, clean though dusty from the road. Hands and objects: the left hand on a young reader's shoulder, the right arm clutching a bundle of rolled dark charts speckled with white points, tied with cord; a long staff. Power: a dark blue shimmer and a thin silver aura of Earth qi round him, a few star-motes drifting from the charts, strong for an elder. Background: a pale road across a high plain, a few robed readers following, blurred in dust-mist. Light: weak pale spirit-light from the upper left lying along the proud line of his nose and the blank white of his eyes, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: proud and blank-eyed, chin lifted, a stubborn honesty in the thin set mouth, walking as if he could see the road.

people.imagined: The array hall counting table; he reaches for a coin and every silver-wire ring on his fingers clicks. He smiles, genial, short of a coin in the lay widows' pay.
people.subject: The moment: at the array hall's counting table he reaches for a coin and every silver-wire ring on his fingers clicks; he smiles, genial, and is short a coin in the lay widows' pay. Face: a round, friendly, shrewd face with bright small brown eyes, a wide smiling mouth, a short moustache, a plump chin; about forty. Hair: black, oiled, in a topknot with a dark star-iron pin. Body: plump, jovial, relaxed, leaning forward on one elbow with a plump hand open and his belly resting on the table edge. Clothing: dry-grass gold silk robes with a silk-lined collar of pale grey fastened by a small silver toggle, a night-blue gauze over-robe with a few embroidered silver stars, sleeves turned back with cuffs of the same grey, a sash edged with a cord of silver thread and hung with a small purse. Hands and objects: a thin silver-wire ring on every finger except the thumbs, eight rings glinting, each differently twisted; a stack of small silver coins in front of him; an open plain book beside them. Power: a faint silver Metal gleam running from ring to ring whenever his fingers move. Background: a dim hall with a large painted diagram of nested circles and dots on the wall, a bone abacus and a small iron strongbox on a shelf, blurred. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left, the silver of the rings flashing with every movement. Expression: a genial, comfortable smile with the eyes doing quiet sums, pleasant and a little too pleased.

people.imagined: A stone courtyard at dusk. She stands so long over the register before she writes a line that the novices call her the Heron; the brush hovers a long time, exactly poised.
people.subject: The moment: in a stone courtyard at dusk she stands perfectly still over a register on a lectern, her brush hovering above the page like a heron about to strike, so long before writing a line that the novices call her the Heron. Face: a long, thin, composed face with a long straight nose, calm grey eyes fixed on the page, thin level brows, a thin closed mouth; about thirty-eight. Hair: black, in a tight low knot with a plain dark star-iron pin. Body: very tall, thin, long-necked and long-legged, standing slightly on one foot, heron-like, one foot lifted so her weight rests on the other, her neck extended forward to read. Clothing: dry-grass gold silk robes in crossed collars, a night-blue gauze over-robe with embroidered silver stars, long narrow sleeves fastened at each wrist with a button of dark iron, a thin gold cord belt knotted at the front, the hem exactly straight; tidy as a pin. Hands and objects: a long brush held vertical, its tip a hair above the page; a round bronze mirror at her belt; a lectern with a wide page of tiny marks; the register bound in pale cloth and open to a column of star-signs; her left hand holds a little brass seal. Power: a thin pale-blue Water mist round the brush tip and a few silver motes hanging still above the page. Background: a stone courtyard with a pattern of seven round dishes set in the paving, one deeper than the rest, a stone bench by a plain wall, dusk mist. Light: low violet light from the left, a last bar of violet sky reflected in a shallow puddle at her feet. Expression: a still, composed gaze fixed on the unwritten line, withdrawn and exact, weighing every stroke before it is made.

people.imagined: The lake shore at night, a boy trimming a lamp so it does not light the patch of water the watcher looks at. Lake birds settle near him, knowing his smell of yak butter and smoke.
people.subject: The moment: at night on the lake shore he crouches with a small lamp, carefully trimming the wick with a tiny blade so it will not light the patch of water the watcher looks at, a heron and ducks settled calmly beside him. Face: a calm, round, trusting young face with soft brown eyes, thick brows, a broad nose, a small gentle smile; about seventeen. Hair: dark brown, thick, cut round like a bowl, under a small cap of grey silk. Body: stocky, quiet, careful, sitting on his heels with his back curved, still as a stone, shoulders relaxed so that the birds do not fear him. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple robe of dry-grass gold silk with a night-blue crossed collar and a bone toggle at the neck, a quilted pale silk vest with trim at the elbows, soft boots stained with lake mud, a rope-twist sash with a small pouch of lamp oil. Hands and objects: a small bronze lamp with a short flame in the left hand; a tiny trimming blade in the right; thumbs blackened with soot; at his feet two ducks and a grey heron on the shore. Power: a faint warm red Fire glow in the flame and a few gold motes rising, the birds' stillness around it. Background: a dark lake and reeds, a line of reed tops waving, a dim hut with one yellow window on the far shore, the reflection of a few stars on the water, mist. Light: lamp from the lower left, warm on his face, a small trembling circle of gold on the shore stones. Expression: a calm, trusting, careful face bent to the wick, the smile small and private, breathing slow so as not to startle the birds.

people.imagined: At the sorting heap, hefting a stone in her palm and speaking its weight aloud; she is never wrong, and is already setting the heaviest discs aside for a sack.
people.subject: The moment: on a heap of rubble at the sorting heap she hefts a dark stone in her palm, eyes half closed as if listening, lips parted to say its weight aloud; she is never wrong, and is already setting the heaviest discs aside for a sack. Face: a calm, straight face with a firm chin, steady grey eyes, level brows, a short nose, a composed mouth; about twenty-three. Hair: black, in a tight practical braid pinned round the head with a dark star-iron pin, a little dust in it. Body: strong, sturdy, a squarish stance, bare strong arms, feet planted wide on the rubble, shoulders level, a calm settled weight like a scale-pan. Clothing: the graceful silk of a junior but proud inner disciple: dry-grass gold robes with a night-blue crossed collar, sleeves tied back to the shoulder, a dark-grey silk work-sash with a wide pocket holding a row of marked pebbles, a stripe of dark star-iron dust from collar to elbow. Hands and objects: a heavy dark star-iron stone resting in the right palm; before her on a cloth a row of dark grey stones lined up by size, each with a pinch of white chalk on its top; a small hand scale. Power: a faint silver Metal hint along the stone's edge, a dull blue-black sheen that seems to hum. Background: heaps of grey and brown spoil, a wheelbarrow, a wooden sorting table, the dark mouth of the mine, a pale sky, mist. Light: bright dry light from the upper left, a low sun lighting the side of the stone to a dull blue-black sheen. Expression: a calm, sure, inward look as if reading a number off the stone, the mouth just ready to speak it.

people.imagined: In the ink room, he sniffs the pot before he stirs it, thumbnails black as beetles, and says nothing about the extra star.
people.subject: The moment: in the ink room he bends over a pot of ink and sniffs it before he stirs it, thumbnails black as beetles, and says nothing about the extra star. Face: a thin, pale, careful young face with large dark eyes, soft brows, a long nose wrinkled at the smell, a mouth pressed shut, a smear of ink on one cheek; about nineteen. Hair: black, tidy, in a knot with a night-blue ribbon. Body: narrow, stooped over the work, elbows out on the table, head bowed over the pot like a man at a well. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple robe of dry-grass gold silk with a night-blue collar and ink-stained cuffs, sleeves pushed to the elbow and tied with a strip of paper, a grey silk work-sash splashed with years of ink, a pocket of folded cloths. Hands and objects: both thumbnails stained black as beetles, clearly visible; a stirring stick in the right hand; a stone pot of dark ink; a lump of ink and a grinding stone; three ink sticks of different sizes, a chipped blue-white dish, a small bundle of brushes. Power: a faint dark blue shade in the ink, with one tiny silver star-mote floating on its surface, more hint than glow. Background: a small ink room with neat rows of stoppered jars on shelves, each with a coloured thread tied round its neck in place of writing, blurred in lamp-mist. Light: a lamp from the upper left making a bright disc on the black surface of the ink. Expression: a careful, shut-lipped quiet, eyes lowered to the pot and giving away nothing, humble in the set of his shoulders.

people.imagined: On a ward-laying job at a farm, grinning with one silver tooth, counting silver coins; she has ringed the barley yard and, with a shrug, left the well outside.
people.subject: The moment: in a farm yard on a ward-laying job she counts silver coins in her palm, grinning with one silver tooth; she has ringed the barley yard and, with a shrug, left the well outside. Face (most important: one silver front tooth): a sharp, tanned, cheeky face with a pointed chin, narrow quick eyes, thin arched brows, a broad grin with one front tooth bright silver, a small scar through one brow; about twenty-one. Hair: black, in a high ponytail with a red silk cord. Body: slim, quick, confident, standing with a hip cocked and her weight on the back foot, a relaxed bounce in her stance. Clothing: the graceful silk of a hired inner disciple: dry-grass gold robes with a night-blue crossed collar, a short night-blue silk jerkin-vest with the seams picked out in red thread and a row of small iron studs, rolled sleeves, a belt of silk cord with small pouches of different colours, one for each job, short trousers, boots. Hands and objects: a handful of silver coins held up in a neat column between finger and thumb, the top one tipped against the light; a small dark flag on a stick under her arm; behind her a barley yard ringed by dark star-iron discs set in the earth. Power: a ring of faint ochre Earth light rises from the discs in the barley yard behind her. Background: a farmstead with a line of low earth walls round the barley yard, the well outside the ring, a farmer and a child watching from the doorway, a cart waiting on the road, light mist. Light: bright light from the upper left glinting in the silver tooth and on the coins. Expression: a cheeky, quick grin full of silver, with a shrug in her shoulders and her eyes already on the next job.

people.imagined: At dawn, wiping an armillary ring with a cloth that always jumps from her hand; she has just chased it across the floor, laughing, smelling of angelica root.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn she stretches on tiptoe to wipe a great dark armillary ring while the wiping cloth slips out of her hand and flutters away; she has just chased it across the floor, laughing, smelling of angelica root. Face: a small, round, freckled, merry face with big honest brown eyes, thick brows, a snub nose, a wide laughing mouth; about sixteen. Hair: dark brown, in two short braids with a twist of dry grass and a night-blue ribbon. Body: small, wiry, on tiptoe, stretched up with one foot off the floor and her free arm out for balance, a quick comical lunge. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-disciple robe of dry-grass gold silk with short sleeves and a night-blue crossed collar, a white silk over-apron smeared across the front with brass polish, a gold cord belt with a sprig of angelica tucked in, its small umbrella-shaped flower-heads showing. Hands and objects: one hand reaching for a cloth in mid-air above the floor; the other pressed against a dark star-iron ring many times her height; a tin of polish and a second cloth on the floor beside her. Power: a faint pale-green Wood sparkle at the angelica and a few silver motes in the bright stripe on the ring where she has wiped. Background: the star-iron ring rising behind her like a great dark wall with polished bands, a slit window above showing a strip of pale sky, soft mist. Light: pale pink dawn from the upper left, a bar of dawn lying across the ring and making a bright stripe where she has already wiped. Expression: a merry, rueful laugh, eyes screwed up and mouth wide, caught out by her own cloth and enjoying it.
